scene_meta.title: Into the Fume-Wastes

scene_meta.participants: Geralt; Oreck; coherent Luminaire; Federation skirmishers overhead
scene_meta.focus: Three weeks of eastward travel, entry into the Fume-Wastes, discovery of the devastated settlement, and first evidence that the wounded scout survived and fled east.
scene_meta.boundary evidence: The source retrospectively summarizes the three-week journey from within the Fume-Wastes and flows directly into the settlement discovery. The journey and discovery remain one travel-to-arrival situation.

scene_meta.hidden/unshown intervals: Departure from the Chapter 049 Ghost Spire aftermath, nightly travel, treatment, armor repair or lack of repair, Five Mika recovery, and most Federation activity during the three weeks are not staged.
scene_meta.chronology qualification: Y17,511 is an editorial working chronology derived from the qualified Chapter 049 endpoint, not a source-exact date. If Chapter 049 ended later than preferred M7 D9, this scene shifts later by the same amount.
scene_meta.continuity flags.Federation clocks: The independent Chapter 049 48-hour compliance deadline and under-72-hour fleet-arrival estimate both expire during the three-week journey. Skirmishers and fugitive bulletins show enforcement activity, but the promised clocks and timing are not explicitly reconciled.

scene_meta.title: Vek'tar recruited / forced jump

scene_meta.boundary evidence: Acts 3–7 form one uninterrupted box-canyon crisis. POV, time, and operating encounter remain continuous through negotiation, fleet interruption, flight, and gate entry.
scene_meta.presentation: encounter, negotiation, mission briefing, chase, flight, and forced transit climax
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Substitute and recruit Vek'tar, commit the group to Umbra, and force the mission to begin without the proposed two-day rest.
scene_meta.hidden/unshown intervals: Vek'tar's survival history, the Kaelen-to-Vek'tar objective substitution, the source of his settlement attack, and any repair or upgrade enabling flight are not shown.

scene_meta.continuity flags.Kaelen / Vek'tar: Chapter 050 silently substitutes Vek'tar for Chapter 049's stated Kaelen recruitment objective. Chapter 054 establishes Kaelen as Vek'tar's trainer, proving they are distinct people. Kaelen's recruitment remains unfulfilled.
scene_meta.continuity flags.sustained flight: Geralt deploys the armor's wings, lifts Oreck, remains airborne while Oreck is suspended in his grip, traverses the canyon, and later lands. This establishes sustained true flight after prior continuity established powered launches and gliding only.
scene_meta.continuity flags.damage / capability con: Sustained flight occurs without a staged repair of the Chapter 048 bent left wing or Chapter 049 cracked and structurally compromised Dragon Mail. No Stage 2 or other upgrade is named, and Luminaire is not shown enabling the flight.
scene_meta.continuity flags.Federation clocks: Federation forces interrupt after three weeks, far beyond both Chapter 049 deadlines. The fleet is triggered by the new map-projection spike and creates a separate twenty-minute tactical clock; the source does not identify it as either earlier promised clock.
scene_meta.continuity flags.campaign count: The offer of five jumps and five spires does not identify the missing fifth target or reconcile the eleven-spire architecture.

scene_meta.state ledger.Dragon Mail: Stage 1 remains highest named stage; damaged but functional, with unsupported expanded flight capability.
scene_meta.state ledger.Luminaire: Coherent, separately audible, and able to create the emergency Void Gate; distinct from Applicator and not the source of the flight.
scene_meta.state ledger.Applicator: Active; diagnoses Vek'tar at 78% chroniton decay; identity and provenance remain unexplained.
scene_meta.state ledger.Zaron: Absent; flight and armor agency are not attributed to him.
scene_meta.state ledger.Oreck: Armorless, cleaver-equipped, and carried while airborne by Geralt.
scene_meta.state ledger.Oreck family: Sythara and twelve juveniles remain behind; Vek'tar's possible-family visions do not establish outcomes or biological parentage.
scene_meta.state ledger.network mission: Umbra Planes becomes the immediate first intervention; Umbrageous remains omitted and the fifth target remains unidentified.

Identity continuity is supported through the intervention; exact consciousness-dissolution mechanics remain unexplained.
